context: Scatter plot of age vs cholesterol for 250 synthetic patients colored by risk group (Low/Moderate/High), with marginal strip plots and boxplots on top and right axes, interactive brush selection, and a dynamic regression line with R².
first_impression: Structurally honest scatter plot with data-driven domains and a colorblind-safe palette, but marginal jitter positions are unstable under brush subsets due to LCG re-seeding.
what_works: Both xScale and yScale use d3.extent for data-driven domains (no hardcoded magic numbers); scatter plot correctly omits a zero baseline; boxplot IQR whiskers and regression are computed correctly from the live selection.
what_doesnt: Marginal strip-dot jitter reseeds the LCG from scratch on each brush update, so persistent points visually jump positions rather than staying fixed — a metamorphic subset-relation failure; regression line endpoints extend to the full dataset domain even when a brushed subset is active, slightly misrepresenting the fit's applicable range.
